title: Founders of Washington copied Egypt with obelisks
place_text: Washington DC; Central Park; France; England

tellings.quote: he explained to me what they knew and how the the people that set Washington up, they did the same thing.

plain: The people who laid out Washington, DC, are said to have copied ancient Egypt by putting up obelisks, as was also done in Central Park, France and England. Chris Bledsoe, a man who says UFOs appear around him, tells Michels this is what a man named Robert Gilbert explained to him. No date is given.
